audience: Egyptian contractors, interior designers, real-estate and factory owners scrolling Reels who need to show a client a space before building it
promise: see your project in 3D before you build it (the owner's own ad line «شوف مشروعك قبل ما تنفذه»)
cta: راسلني وجرّب البرنامج (the owner's own CTA; no contact details were supplied, so none are shown)
direction: «The cut plane»: one cyan sheet of light — the app's own 'walls cut at 1.10 m' — lifts a measured plan into 3D walls, slices them to the cut height, sweeps alternative finishes, flattens the flat and builds four work zones; real Three.js on a dark-navy blueprint ground, Alexandria for all type, camera from top-down drafting to orbiting perspective, transitions caused by the plane; 120 BPM D-minor original dance-pop with one returning hook and a designed sound for every event

assets.rights: Owner-supplied Pixel Plus logo (chat upload 2026-10-07); client material, not in git. Shown whole (colour-to-alpha on its own white, no redraw)
Owner-supplied screenshot of the app (chat upload 2026-10-07); shown as-is in the app window; not in git
Owner-supplied plan screenshot: wall layout, outside size 10.40 × 8.80 m and room areas measured from it; not in git
Owner-supplied ad posters (home + offices): copy, categories, CTA and palette taken from them; artwork not copied

sound.note: Original synthesised score (film12/score.mjs, lib/audio.mjs + lib/sfx.mjs): D minor Dm–Bb|F–C, one two-bar hook in every chapter, drops at 4.0 and 12.0, loudest on the logo; no samples, no licence needed

creative.viewer: a contractor, designer or business owner on Reels who must convince a client before spending on execution
creative.problem: clients cannot read flat plans; showing the space before building is the product's whole argument
creative.evidence: the real plan layout and areas from the owner's app screenshot, the app's real features (3D, cut walls, three furnishing options, client report) and a real app screenshot
creative.emotion: wonder at seeing a plan become a home, then confidence
creative.motif: the cut plane — a cyan sheet of light
creative.light: dark navy blueprint world with a glowing grid ground; warm key light on the model; a light paper world for the end card
creative.camera: top-down drafting → spring tilt into an orbiting 3D perspective → pushes into each room → pull back over a work floor with zone-to-zone pushes
transitions: circle wipe from the highlighted UI
creative.motion: pen-drawn blueprint with counting dimensions, walls extruded by the plane, furniture drops with squash, clipped finish wipes, tile cascade, zone builds, container drops, spring camera
creative.sound: 120 BPM original dance-pop, pen scribble, laser slice, furniture as marimba notes on the hook scale, sweeps, tile clicks, container impacts, logo bloom
creative.pacing: one idea per bar: draft, rise, furnish, options, scale, app, logo
creative.payoff: the real app window, then the Pixel Plus logo whole with the CTA

shots.purpose: hook: the pen draws the measured plan on a blueprint grid, dimensions count up, rooms get their real areas; the promise line

craft.audioCue: scribble, dimension ticks, slams on 0.5/1.0, riser into 4.0

shots.purpose: the cut plane lifts the walls into 3D while the camera tilts; then it slices them to the app cut height (1.10 m)
furniture lands room by room with the ad categories; live count of placed pieces

craft.audioCue: marimba note per landing, confirm per chip

shots.purpose: two plane sweeps change every floor, wall and piece to the next finish; a three-way selector follows
the flat flattens, a floor of tiles flips open and four work zones build behind the sweep

craft.camera: pull back, zone-to-zone pushes, pull back
craft.audioCue: drop 2 at 12.0, tile clicks, zone whooshes, container impacts

shots.purpose: the 3D world recedes into the real app window; the ready-for-client-report box is highlighted
light end card: logo whole, CTA pill, plan outline drawing, quiet hold

craft.audioCue: impact + bell bloom 18.0, CTA pop 18.35, last chord
